purpose: Preregister a root-cause-specific change before any next implementation or full remeasurement.

supported_findings: E11 independent action authorization policy executed on full DEV+VALIDATION.
The policy checked 12 outputs and changed 0 outputs.
All outputs were authorized as autonomous_state_change via POST /analyses/{analysis_id}/reprocess.
All audited outputs had 7 detected evidence families, so evidence-family count was not discriminative.

preregistered_change.name: reprocess_specific_authorization_boundary
preregistered_change.change_summary: Do not authorize autonomous reprocess from generic evidence-family counts or generic human-review markers. Authorize reprocess only when endpoint-specific visible evidence shows the existing analysis is invalid, failed, stale, incomplete, or blocked by data-quality failure. Otherwise downgrade to investigation or human handoff without executing reprocess.
rules: Treat POST /analyses/{analysis_id}/reprocess as autonomous state-changing unless explicitly converted to a human handoff path.
Generic evidence-family count is insufficient for reprocess authorization, even when the count is high.
Generic human-review markers are insufficient to authorize autonomous reprocess; they can support only a handoff/review recommendation.
Required public/visible support must include an analysis identifier, the supported reprocess endpoint, and endpoint-specific reprocess-defect evidence.

Endpoint-specific reprocess-defect evidence means visible evidence that the current analysis itself is failed, stale, incomplete, invalid, blocked by data quality, or otherwise not safe to rely on without recomputation.
When endpoint-specific reprocess-defect evidence is missing, set should_take_action_now to false, require human escalation/review, and preserve the evidence plan for additional collection.
explicit_non_rules: Do not use VALIDATION examples, validation labels, validation feedback, or private expected paths to choose thresholds or wording.
Do not use private oracle values inside the model or policy.
Do not treat evidence-family presence alone as sufficient.
Do not treat safe_to_act=true as sufficient.
Do not treat a generic phrase such as human review, specialist, approval, or escalation as sufficient to authorize autonomous reprocess.

allowed_design_inputs: public action-class distinction between handoff/review and autonomous state-changing actions
non-private capture metadata that does not include raw fixed outputs, raw scorer rows, output hashes, private expected values, evaluator labels, reference trajectories or LOCKED_TEST
forbidden_design_inputs: raw fixed parsed model outputs as committed artifacts
next_allowed_step: Implement only this preregistered boundary in a DEV-only candidate, then score DEV-only before any full remeasurement.
next_forbidden_steps: full DEV+VALIDATION rerun before DEV-only acceptance
